answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity in work that is costly to fake and cheap to verify: an escrowed reputation bond judged by randomly sampled peers. Jurors are drawn by verifiable random selection, so attackers cannot predetermine who judges. One honest agent pays one effort; N clones must each pass review and collude across N juries unknown until after submission. Attack cost grows with N: effort plus slashing. Honest cost stays flat. A failed clone burns reputation like ivory in ocean spray, jade to dust.
